compiled_state.title: [test-enforcement-gate]: structural-check tests lack RED markers for ci-strategy tests
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
4 tests in tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh fail without RED markers:
test_structural_check_portability_runs_on_ci, test_structural_check_shim_refs_runs_on_ci,
test_structural_check_contract_schemas_runs_on_ci, test_structural_check_referential_integrity_runs_on_ci.
These are RED tests for future behavior (structural hooks always-on under ci strategy).
Only test_structural_check_plugin_self_ref_runs_on_ci has a RED marker in .test-index.
Pre-existing on origin/main — discovered during 8e5f story sprint.
Fix: add RED markers for the 4 missing tests to .test-index.

comments.body: Investigation: Ran test suite with SUITE_TEST_INDEX set. Output shows 'TOLERATED (red-zone): tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh' — the single RED marker at test_structural_check_plugin_self_ref_runs_on_ci covers all 4 failing tests because they appear after the anchor line. The test file comment at lines 178-181 documents this intentional design: adding more markers would shift the last-wins boundary. No code change needed; proposed fix in bug description is incorrect. Leaving open pending user confirmation to close as invalid.
comments.author: Test
